stories.title: Ravens' Lamar Jackson out for game with thumb injury suffered on 1st play
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bills with a right thumb injury.
stories.detail: ORCHARD PARK, N.Y. -- Lamar Jackson 's return lasted one play. Jackson, the star quarterback for the Baltimore Ravens , was ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Buffalo Bills with a right thumb injury. He hurt his thumb on his first play in Sunday's game. While throwing a pass, Jackson had his right hand struck by the hand of Bills outside linebacker Greg Rousseau , who was attempting to knock down the throw. The two-time NFL MVP immediately looked down at his hand and went to the sideline. He went into the tunnel with his right hand wrapped and held by a trainer. It only got worse for the Ravens in the second quarter, when Tyler "Snoop" Huntley , who was 2-for-4 for zero yards, left the game with a right toe injury. Huntley was ruled out in the third quarter. With Jackson and Huntley injured, Baltimore turned to No. 3 quarterback Joe Fagnano , an undrafted rookie out of Connecticut . Fagnano, who made his first regular-season appearance after an impressive preseason, finished the game 10 of 21 passing for 91 yards and an interception. This was Jackson's first game back after missing the past three games with a high ankle sprain. It's a devastating loss for Ba…

stories.title: Inside the complicated injury history of Ravens' Lamar Jackson
stories.summary: If the QB's health record has taught the football world anything, his timeline to return can be challenging.
stories.detail: Lamar Jackson 's 2026 season is turning into the most injury-filled one of his nine-year career. Jackson missed three games with a high left ankle sprain and returned only to injure his right thumb on his first snap of Sunday's game at the Buffalo Bills . If Jackson's injury history has taught the football world anything, his timeline to return can be complicated and an extended absence can derail the Ravens' season. But ultimately, the only one who truly knows when Jackson will return is Jackson himself. "Look, if he's able to play, [is] healthy enough to play and play the way that obviously we feel like he needs to play, then he will play," coach Jesse Minter said Monday. Two weeks ago, there was a feeling within the team that Jackson was going to be able to play last Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals . He practiced as a limited participant all week, worked with the first-team offense that Friday and took part in the television production meetings, which usually signifies he will be the starting quarterback. But Jackson was ruled out last Saturday after he experienced increased swelling in his injured left ankle, according to a report during the CBS game broadcast. Tracy Wol…

stories.summary: The Ravens could be without their quarterback for a while due to another injury.
stories.detail: It's stunning to think that the Baltimore Ravens could have almost a decade of one of the greatest quarterbacks of all time and not make the Super Bowl once. The two-time MVP's return brought hope that he could lift the Ravens back to being a Super Bowl contender, starting with a win at the Buffalo Bills. One offensive play in, all that hope was gone. Jackson suffered a thumb injury following through on a pass on the Ravens' first play on offense. He went to the locker room and was ruled out shortly after. stories.title: Goff throws go-ahead touchdown pass to Williams and Lions beat Vikings 19-15 for their 1st loss
stories.summary: — Jared Goff threw a go-ahead, 7-yard touchdown pass to Jameson Williams with 4:35 left and the Detroit Lions beat the Minnesota Vikings 19-15 on...
stories.detail: DETROIT -- — Jared Goff threw a go-ahead, 7-yard touchdown pass to Jameson Williams with 4:35 left and the Detroit Lions beat the Minnesota Vikings 19-15 on Sunday, handing the NFL's last undefeated team its first loss. The Lions (5-2) have won three straight, including their first two division games in the tight NFC North. The Vikings (6-1) had a chance to stay unbeaten, but the league's stingiest defense couldn't hold onto a late lead, and they lost for the first time since Nov. 30, 2025, at Seattle. Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards, including a 30-yard, tackle-breaking touchdown in the third quarter. Goff was 18 of 25 for 176 yards with a touchdown and his first interception of the season. Kyler Murray was 17 of 29 for 210 yards with two touchdown and an interception, leading an offensively challenged team that had just 81 yards rushing. The Lions broke a scoreless tie late in the first quarter on Jake Bates ' 25-yard field goal after their star receivers — Amon Ra-St. Brown and Williams — stunted the first two drives with taunting penalties St. Brown had a chance to make up for his flag with a touchdown catch, but the play was reversed after a review that showed he did…

stories.title: Bucs down Falcons without pass completion; Bucky Irving, Kenny Gainwell run wild
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.
stories.detail: TAMPA, Fla. -- Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass but the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the Atlanta Falcons 16-0 on Sunday behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell 's rushing on a wet, sloppy field. The Buccaneers (3-5) set a team record for yards rushing in a game with 324, and became the first team to have zero completions since Buffalo on Sept. 29, 1974. The Bills beat the Jets 16-12 in that one, and that had been the only time a team didn't complete a pass in the Super Bowl era. Irving ran for 170 yards and one touchdown on 27 carries, Gainwell ran for 140 on 25 carries. Before Sunday, there had never been a game in NFL history where two teammates both had at least 25 rushing attempts and 125 rushing yards. Also, Chase McLaughlin kicked three field goals to stay perfect this season at 19 for 19. Playing in a driving rain for most of the afternoon, Mayfield was 0 for 3 in his second game back after missing three weeks with a fractured thumb. Tampa Bay finished with minus-2 net passing yards thanks to a sack. It got got 100.6% of its offensive yards on the ground (324 of 322). stories.title: Vikings' reign as NFL's last undefeated team comes to end with loss to Lions
stories.summary: The Vikings' reign as the NFL's lone remaining undefeated team is over, as Minnesota fell to the Lions on Sunday.
stories.detail: The NFL's last unbeaten team has fallen. The Minnesota Vikings saw their unblemished start come to an end Sunday, Nov. 1, falling in a 19-15 loss to the Detroit Lions . The Vikings' defense once again created havoc for the team's NFC North rival in the early going, with the unit bagging Lions quarterback Jared Goff for four sacks. But Detroit broke through in the second half with two touchdown drives. Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs, who finished with 153 rushing yards on 23 carries, scored the first touchdown when he broke free on a 30-yard jaunt in the third quarter. Gibbs then powered a fourth-quarter drive that was capped by a 7-yard touchdown connection between Goff and wide receiver Jameson Williams. Outside of wide receiver Justin Jefferson tipping an end zone fade to himself in the second quarter, Minnesota's offense once again struggled to find a spark. The Vikings were outgained 384 yards to 266, and quarterback Kyler Murray generated just 210 yards on 17-of-29 passing. Murray did manage to help the offense come alive in the fourth quarter, when he uncorked a 51-yard deep heave to Jordan Addison. An 8-yard strike temporarily put Minnesota back on top before the Lions reg…

teamStories.title: Jets waste offensive outburst in costly 38-33 loss to Raiders
teamStories.summary: The Jets' offense erupted for 33 points, but defensive breakdowns and a costly kickoff return helped the Raiders secure a 38-33 win at MetLife Stadium.
teamStories.detail: The Jets had their best offensive performance in some time on Sunday, but it wasn’t enough as their defense and special teams unit failed to hold up their end of the bargain. In addition, when the offense had a chance to take a late lead, it came up short once again as the Las Vegas Raiders held on for a 38-33 win at MetLife Stadium. New York took an early lead on a short field goal by Jason Sanders , but the Raiders drove downfield on their first possession to take a 7-3 lead on a Kirk Cousins 12-yard pass to Brock Bowers . After another Jets field goal, they got the ball back and took a 13-7 lead on Geno Smith ’s 18-yard pass to Isaiah Williams , but the Raiders retook the lead immediately as Dylan Laube returned the ensuring kickoff 95 yards for a score. The Jets scored twice more before halftime to lead 23-14 as Smith threw another touchdown pass to Adonai Mitchell , then New York kicked a field goal just before half time. Prior to that kick, the Jets had been outscored 107-6 in the last two minutes of the first half during the Aaron Glenn era. The Raiders soon got back into the game, as Cousins wrapped up another good drive with a two-yard pass to Bowers. The Jets responded i…

teamStories.title: Raiders end losing streak with 38-33 win over Jets
teamStories.summary: Kirk Cousins threw three touchdowns to get the Raiders to 4-4 on the year.
teamStories.detail: The Dolphins picked up their first win of the 2026 season against the Jets at MetLife Stadium in Week 7 and the Raiders found it to be a hospitable place to play in Week 8. Kirk Cousins threw three touchdowns and ran for another as the Raiders ended their four-game losing streak with a 38-33 win over the Jets. The victory bumps their record to 4-4 ahead of a Week 9 trip to face the 49ers at Levi's Stadium. Cousins's third touchdown pass of the day went to Jalen Nailor with 11:33 left to play in the game and it put the Raiders up 35-30 after they trailed by nine points at halftime. They allowed the Jets to drive the ball to their 13, but their defense was able to come up with a stop that led to Jason Sanders's fourth field goal of the day. Raiders running back Mike Washington ran for one first down and the Jets used all their timeouts before a Cousins sneak on third down gave them another one at the two minute warning. The Jets were able to stop the Raiders on the next third down and Matt Gay hit a 53-yard field goal with 27 seconds left to play. The Jets got the ball back and a penalty on a Garrett Wilson catch got them into Raiders territory, but Smith chucked one into the end zo…

teamStories.title: Raiders take 35-30 lead early in fourth quarter
teamStories.summary: Defense has been lacking for both teams at MetLife Stadium and the Raiders have taken advantage of the Jets' shortcomings to move back into the lead.
teamStories.detail: Defense has been lacking for both teams at MetLife Stadium and the Raiders have taken advantage of the Jets' shortcomings to move back into the lead. Kirk Cousins hit wide receiver Jalen Nailor for a two-yard score with 11:33 left to play and the Raiders now lead the Jets 35-30. It's the first time the Raiders have been in front since early in the second quarter. Cousins has now completed three touchdown passes on the day and he has run for another score. Cousins's biggest passing play on the drive came on a short pass to running back Ashton Jeanty, who stumbled and got up without being touched on his way to a 45-yard gain. The Jets scored on their first six possessions, but punted after a penalty and a sack left them with a second-and-27 on their last possession. They'll need to get back into their offensive groove to avoid a third straight loss.

teamStories.title: Rex Ryan rips Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty, who takes backseat role against Jets
teamStories.summary: ESPN analyst Rex Ryan, a former Jets head coach, ripped Las Vegas Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty, who issued bulletin-board material before facing New York.
teamStories.detail: The lack of production from the Las Vegas Raiders ' run game during the 2026 season falls on the entire offensive unit and first-year head coach Klint Kubiak, along with his staff. But the rushing woes have magnified the plight of one specific player: Raiders' running back Ashton Jeanty, in his second season of pro ball after Las Vegas selected him sixth overall in the 2025 draft. The Raiders (3-4) entered the Week 8 matchup against the New York Jets ranked 31st in rushing yards per game (74.7) and 31st in yards per rush, a category they were also ranked last in a season ago). The Raiders handed center Tyler Linderbaum the richest contract in the history of the position (three years, $81 million) to help bolster a lackluster offensive line. Jeanty was averaging 3.1 yards per carry entering the game against the Jets – down from his rookie-year mark of 3.7. However, Jeanty saw the matchup as an opportunity to get the run game back on track, however. He also took a shot at the Jets defense in the process. teamStories.title: Spurs' Victor Wembanyama notches 43 points on career-high 34 shots in win
teamStories.summary: Victor Wembanyama launched a career-high 34 shots for a season-high 43 points to propel the Spurs to a 121-111 win over the Timberwolves.
teamStories.detail: SAN ANTONIO -- Spurs star Victor Wembanyama launched a career-high 34 shots for a season-high 43 points Saturday to propel San Antonio to a 121-111 win over the Timberwolves . "When he plays with his teammates, it really causes a problem for the other team, whether that's spacing, handling the basketball, playing two-man game or three-man game," Spurs coach Mitch Johnson said. "The best players in this league, when they play with their teammates, it's damn near impossible at times [to stop]. You've got to just choose how they beat you. He's made some fine improvement in a short amount of time." Wembanyama's performance marked the first time the Spurs emerged victorious on a night the Frenchman finished with 30 attempts or more. The 22-year-old also contributed five blocks to become the first Spurs player since David Robinson (1996) to rack up at least 40 points and five blocks in a game and the first player in the NBA since Joel Embiid (2022) to accomplish the feat. San Antonio fell short the two previous times Wembanyama hoisted 30 shots or more. He attempted 31 shots on Christmas Day of his second NBA season (2024) to finish with 42 points in a 117-114 loss to the New York Knick…
